Structurally, the text investigates conditional relations by cross-combining the categories of the visible triad (*sanidassanattika*) with the triad of states leading to the accumulation of rebirth (*ācayagāmittika*) [SuttaCentral]. There is no specific discussion of this section in the surveyed modern secondary literature.
